name: Bounty Hunter Ludy
source:
Ludy is a famous space bounty hunter with top notch skills. But she's famous mostly for her ability to fall into troubles due because of uncontrolled destruction power. In order to deal with the debts she goes to casino but drenches down into even deeper debt. She is offered a top secret military case and she's in no position to reject it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
露迪是技艺高超的知名太空赏金猎人，却更因无法控制破坏力、总会陷入麻烦而闻名。为处理债务，她来到赌场，却又欠下更多债。有人向她提供一件绝密军事案件，而她没有拒绝的余地。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
